# Stephen Siapno

> Senior Android engineer in the Philippines. He started with native Android in 2016 and today builds Kotlin Multiplatform apps and libraries. He works AI-first, leading AI agents that write and test the code. He runs SiapKnow, an AI-first studio where AI agents plan, build, test and release real apps under his direction and approval. Its app Myrna & Judith is live on the App Store and Google Play. By day he is a Mobile Engineer at EROAD.

- Email: stephen.siapno7@gmail.com
- Resume (PDF): https://thesetox.github.io/resources/stephen_siapno_cv.pdf
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/stephen-siapno/
- GitHub: https://github.com/TheSetox
- Studio: https://siapknow.com/

## Featured work

- [SiapKnow](https://siapknow.com/): an AI-first studio for apps, developer tools and films, running since April 2026. MainHarness, his delivery harness, turns AI agents into a disciplined team; parallel Claude Code sessions do the work; he approves every plan and release. Counted on Nov 23, 2026 (agent hours, sessions and sub-agent runs count only the Claude Code logs still on the machine): 6,281 commits across 8 repositories, 336 pull requests merged, 8,118 automated tests in Myrna & Judith, 1,062 agent hours, 39 sessions with up to 13 at once, and 34 Reels and films.
- [Myrna & Judith](https://myrnaandjudith.com/): a bill and payday tracker for Filipinos ("Know what's due before payday"). Live on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/myrna-judith/id6767477202) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.myrnaandjudith). Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform, offline-first, no account or backend. Built with no manual development: 5,069 commits on main, 292 pull requests merged, 35 modules, 8,118 tests and 34 store builds (as of Nov 23, 2026). The first production version took two weeks.

## Also built

- [CommitPath](https://thesetox.github.io/commitpath-site/): a free, offline Kotlin knowledge refresher with flashcards and guided lessons, on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/ph/app/commitpath-learn-kotlin/id6816756095). Version 2, with AI flashcards, is in progress.
- [MainHarness](https://siapknow.com/#process): a portable delivery harness (17 skills, 5 roles, 12 rule sets, 9 tools) that gives AI agents a planning contract, verified commits and human shipping gates. It runs on Codex, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code. The repository is private.
- [KMP Sample Diagrams](https://thesetox.github.io/kmp-sample-diagrams/): editable Kotlin Multiplatform architecture diagrams and runnable Android, iOS and desktop samples ([source](https://github.com/TheSetox/kmp-sample-diagrams)).
- [Fluent and Fun Clean Architecture](https://medium.com/@setoxsiapno/list/fluent-and-fun-clean-architecture-9ef86201becf): a five-part article series on ProAndroidDev, with a [Kotlin Multiplatform playground](https://github.com/TheSetox/KMP-Fun-Clean-Architecture).

## Experience

- EROAD, Mobile Engineer (June 2025 to present): Mobile Foundation team; internal Kotlin Multiplatform libraries for telemetry and shared UI; modernizing legacy Android apps toward a modular architecture; moved CI/CD from Azure DevOps to GitHub Actions; AI-assisted workflows with AGENTS.md, skills and MCP.
- Digiplus, Senior Android Developer (October 2024 to May 2025): architected two apps for a gaming and entertainment company using native Android and Kotlin Multiplatform; introduced Jetpack Compose, Ktor, Koin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
- Accenture, Android Engineer, then Senior Android Engineer, then Android Specialist (Lead-equivalent) (February 2020 to October 2024): led more than 20 Android and embedded TV apps for an international client; delivered four Android modules; led five Android developers and mentored two engineers.
- Yondu, Android Developer (February 2018 to November 2019): sole Android developer on an internal relationship-management app; data sync 80% faster; 10 production features; weekly releases.
- Auspex Corp., Android Developer (April 2017 to January 2018): an offline-first Android app.
- Mobext, Mobile Developer (June 2016 to April 2017): built the Bonifacio Global City iOS app from scratch in Xamarin (C#) with MVVM, in three months; maintained Android apps for McDonald's, Krispy Kreme, Yellow Cab, Pancake House and Max's Restaurant.
- Education: BS Information Technology, University of Pangasinan (PHINMA Network), 2016.

## Skills

Kotlin, Java; Android SDK, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform; MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture, modular architecture; Coroutines, Flow, Koin, Hilt, Dagger, Ktor, Retrofit, OkHttp, Room, RxJava; Mockito, Espresso, Appium, MobSF, SonarQube; Gradle, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Firebase, Sentry; Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, MCP.
